results.description:
I Am Sober is more than just a free sobriety counter app.

Along with tracking your sober days, it helps you build new habits and provides ongoing motivation by connecting you to a wide network of people all striving for the same goal: staying sober one day at a time.

Through our growing sober community you can learn from others and contribute by sharing insights and tactics that have worked for you.

**The I Am Sober app features:**

• Sober day tracker
To visualize how long you’ve been sober.

• Remember why you quit
Add reasons and photos to help you remember why you want to quit your addiction and stay sober.

• Daily pledge tracker
Take a pledge every day. Sobriety is a 24-hour struggle, so start your day off by making a pledge to stay sober. Then you can review how your day went and log notes at the end of the day.

• Sobriety calculator
View how much money & time you’ve saved by being sober.

• Analyze triggers
Recap each day and find patterns that made your day easier or more challenging than the last.

• Share your story
Either with others or for yourself, take photos and journal your progress directly in the app. Then choose to share it or save it as a reminder for yourself.

• Milestone tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond. Compare experiences with others on their sober journey. Read how they felt at this milestone and what you can expect. If you’re struggling, share your story and invite others to offer help or advice.

• Withdrawal timeline
When you create an account and declare your addiction, you can instantly see a withdrawal timeline to get an idea of what to expect for your next few days (and weeks). What’s more, you can contribute to it. See how many others saw an increase in their restfulness vs those that saw an increase in anxiety. Prepare yourself for what’s to come in recovery.

• Customize your experience
You set the time, your sober birthday, the category of motivation you need, the addictions you’re trying to break, even the end-of-day summaries. Make the app customized to your lifestyle and tailored to your needs.

**Sober Plus subscriptions**

I Am Sober is free to use, but you can support development of the app with a subscription to Sober Plus. With Sober Plus, you'll get access to these premium features:

• Create a group
Stay accountable together and track your sobriety privately. Groups are great for complimenting your real-world group like Alcoholics Anonymous, NA, SA, SMART Recovery, or your rehab center.

• Locked access
Keep your trackers private with a lock that you can access via TouchID or FaceID.

• Data Backups
Save your progress in the cloud and restore your trackers if you get a new device.

• More tracking
Track more addictions and get access to more communities. Even if your addiction is specific like Wine, Online Shopping, or Skin Picking, you’ll find a variety of communities of people who are all trying to get sober from alcohol, drugs, eating disorders, self-harm, and more.

results.description:
You've checked the boxes. The day still didn't happen.

Routinery tracks your routines and then runs them with you.

App of the Day 2026 (Apple) - Best ADHD App of 2025 (Forbes Health) - 5 million downloads

A habit tracker, routine tracker and day planner in one. Stack small habits into a daily routine, break it into 1-5 minute steps, and each step runs on its own timer while a voice calls out what comes next.

Morning routines, bedtime wind-downs, study blocks, workouts, medication - anything with a fixed order runs the same way.

WHY IT WORKS
- Starting gets easier. "Study" is too big to begin; "sit at the desk, 1 min" is not. Small steps lower the cost of the first move.
- Nothing to decide mid-run. You set the order once, when you built the routine. Nothing left to choose means less to stall on.
- Wins come back often. A finish is logged every step, not once a day.
- No time math. You set each step's length once. Sink into one thing and the voice pulls you out, so an afternoon doesn't vanish.

ASK CHATGPT OR CLAUDE TO BUILD IT
- "Make me a 40-minute weekday morning routine" and it lands in the app.
- Your assistant can handle routines alongside other tools you've connected there, like Google Calendar.
- Connects to ChatGPT, Claude and others over our MCP server, included in the free plan.

IT STARTS ON TIME, SCREEN OR NOT
- Set the weekdays and time; the reminder arrives then. Weekdays only, three times a week, whatever your schedule.
- The voice reads each step aloud, so the routine keeps running while you shower or cook.
- A home screen widget shows today's list without opening the app.
- Start on the phone, carry on from watch, tablet, or Mac.

STAY DEEP IN ONE THING
- A pomodoro that announces the next task, so the block keeps its own momentum.
- Build the environment: white noise, Focus mode, landscape view, Shortcuts.
- Stretch a timer, skip a step, reorder what's left - all without leaving the run.

DON'T DO IT ALONE
- Share a routine's task list with family or a friend and see how far each of you got.
- Finish a routine and the result goes straight to the person you picked.

SEE IT ADD UP
- A plant grows for each day you keep a streak; weekly and monthly stats show what holds.

FOR THE DAILY AND THE ONE-OFF
- Keep undated tasks and weekly repeats in one daily routine planner.
- A one-time task gets a timer too.
- Can't face it now? Park it in Anytime for later.
- Shift work that moves weekly still fits: Morning, Afternoon, Evening.
- See the day as a list, a calendar, or a timeline.

WHO USES ROUTINERY
- Adults with ADHD who know the task and still can't start
- People who lose hours once they sink into something
- People who double-check in case they missed one
- Anyone who waits to start until they can do it perfectly
- Shift workers, people on daily medication, parents on the school run
- Anyone who wrote a routine down and never once ran it

ROUTINERY AT A GLANCE

Is Routinery free?
Yes. 2 routines free, no account, first one running in under a minute. Premium lifts the routine cap: monthly, 6-month or yearly. The free plan shows ads; Premium is ad-free.

Do I need an account, and what about privacy?
No account, no sign-up. Routine data is stored on our servers; usage analytics go through third-party tools. What you type is never used to train AI models. Email hello@routinery.app and we delete your data.

Does Routinery work offline?
Almost entirely. Routines, timers, voice, reminders and history run offline. Only device sync needs a connection.

What does Routinery connect to?
Siri Shortcuts, widgets, Apple Watch, and AI assistants over MCP. No direct sync with Apple Health or calendars. No export button either; pull your data out over MCP instead, free plan included.

What devices does Routinery run on?
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. No web version.

Questions, bugs or ideas: hello@routinery.app

Routinery is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat ADHD.

Invite someone you trust: rent for two, a trip with friends, a house deposit, or a sinking fund for the bill you know is coming. You both work from one screen showing where you are and what's next.

results.description:
Goal Timer is a warm, encouraging stopwatch for the time you put into what matters — measured in hours, not checkmarks.

Habit apps ask "did you?" Goal Timer asks "how much?" A single tap starts the clock. Whenever you work toward a goal, start the timer and forget it's running — your hours quietly accumulate into visible, compounding progress.

THE HOURS ADD UP
Most tracking apps count streaks and checkmarks. Goal Timer counts the one thing that actually builds skills, fitness, and craft: time. See total hours tracked, your last 7 days, and how close you are to your target — with a live count-up and full per-period history.

THREE TAPS TO VISIBLE PROGRESS
1. Name your goal, pick a colour, and — if you like — set a target.
2. Whenever you work on it, start the timer.
3. Watch the hours add up toward what matters.

BUILT TO BE TRUSTWORTHY
The timer is timestamp-based, so your time is safe even if the app closes, restarts, or your phone dies mid-session. Run several timers at once — deep work and a workout, together. An ongoing notification shows every running timer, and you can stop it right from the notification shade.

ONE-TIME TOTALS OR RECURRING GOALS
Accumulate hours toward a single lifetime target, or set a goal that resets each day or week. Every finished period is quietly filed into a history you can look back on, so your stats keep their full story.

SEE WHERE YOUR HOURS GO

results.description:
Brisk is a goal tracker for people who work out. Set a target like "run 100 km by September" or "cycle 3x a week until the end of August," and Brisk fills in your progress automatically from your Apple Health workouts.

Nothing to log by hand. You set the target once, and every workout you record moves the number. Swim 20 hours this year. Burn 5,000 kcal rowing. Walk 500 km before the year is out.


TWO WAYS TO SET A GOAL

• Reach a total by a date: build toward a cumulative distance, time, or active energy. "Hike 200 km before winter."

• Keep up a routine: commit to a number of workouts a week or a month, until a date. "Strength train 12 times a month until March." Add a condition when only certain workouts should count, like runs over 5 km.

Either way you get a finish line, and that is the point. Brisk is built for the goal you chase over months, not a daily checkbox.


POWERED BY APPLE HEALTH

Brisk reads your workouts from Apple Health. Keep using the watch and the apps you already like. When a new workout lands, your goal moves on its own. Brisk only ever reads your health data, and never changes a thing.

Build a goal around any of 26 workout types, from running, cycling, and swimming to strength training, rowing, hiking, yoga, and more.


KNOW WHERE YOU STAND

See progress toward every goal at a glance, and whether you are ahead of pace or behind it.

Open a goal for the full picture: your total so far, what is left, how many days remain, and the pace you need to finish on time.

Put a goal on your Home Screen with the Brisk widget, and share a finished goal as a card you can post anywhere.


PICK YOUR VOICE

Choose how Brisk talks to you. The Drill Sergeant gives it to you blunt, the Coach is honest and encouraging, and the Cheerleader is relentlessly upbeat. Your pick shapes every reminder and every note on your goal screens, and you can change it any time in Settings.

Reminders arrive when a deadline is close or your progress starts slipping, and stay quiet otherwise.


BRISK PREMIUM

Brisk is free to use with one active goal. Brisk Premium unlocks unlimited active goals, plus every premium feature added in the future, as a yearly subscription with a free trial.
